name: sleepdebt-isolated
note: The DE-CONFOUNDED deadliness demonstration for task kd-O4cnSe10cW / decision kd-h28QBb1lvO. The sweatshop A/B (sleepdebt-measure.json) works crabs to death by EVERY means at once -- 6-24 +OT starves and dirties them too -- so net deaths are neglect-saturated and the sleep-debt signal is buried (advice kd-1XqylH3kmJ: a probe must isolate effect from plumbing). --fed zeroes hunger/thirst/dirt at every settlement, keeps the crew housed, and grants sick days, so the ONLY lethal pathway that ramps is sleep debt -- Matt's ceiling-probe scenario (a well-run town whose crew is merely sleep-deprived) made lethal. Three arms, same 32 seeds, only the hatch varies: control (--nodebt, pre-ramp: a debt illness cannot exist, exhaustion illness rescues) / ramp (--nodebtlane, ramp on, bar off: debt illness lands in a good care lane and rescues) / ramp+bar (shipped: debt illness lands in `spent` and kills). Expect deaths ~0 -> ~0 -> N, all `spent`. SIMLIB_REALM=main + SIMLIB_KERNEL=wasm by env so the only variable across arms is the hatch.
